description: Act on the user's applications. decision "approve" submits each waiting application on the employer's hiring system under the user's name: it spends one of their applications per job and cannot be undone. "reject" skips it: nothing is sent and nothing is spent. "cancel" stops one that is still queued or preparing. "refine" rewrites its resume or cover letter from instructions (document_type and instructions; uses AI credits). "re_prepare" builds its documents again (optional steps). "set_stage" records how it is going (stage). Pass up to 25 application_ids from aiapplyd_get_applications. Only approve on the user's explicit go-ahead, such as a "yes" to a specific application. On a timeout or an error, call aiapplyd_get_applications before retrying; an approve that already went through is reported as already approved. Do not use it for matches with no application yet; use aiapplyd_apply or aiapplyd_triage_matches. Next: aiapplyd_get_applications to follow the submissions.

application_ids.description: Application ids to act on, 1 to 25 (e.g. [1550, 1551]), from aiapplyd_get_applications

decision.description: "approve" submits the application to the employer and cannot be undone. "reject" skips it and sends nothing. "cancel" stops a queued one. "refine" rewrites a document (needs document_type and instructions). "re_prepare" builds its documents again. "set_stage" records the stage (needs stage).

instructions.description: For refine: what to change, in the user's own words (up to 2,000 characters).

stage.description: For set_stage: applied, callback, phone_screen, interview, offered, rejected or no_response.

steps.description: For re_prepare: the steps to run again. Omit to run every step that is out of date.

name: aiapplyd_review_application

notConfirmed.description: True when the user declined the confirmation prompt and nothing was sent.

reason.description: Machine reason when ok is false, or "already_approved" for an approve that had already gone through.

status.description: Our own record after the action. Never proof the employer received it.

title: Approve or Reject Applications
